alex: quick summary — ran a 7d sim of mixed spot pools (A100 / H100 / G5) in us-west-2 to optimize cost vs 99th%-latency. patterns look... interesting. any thoughts on orchestration-level fallback?
jamal: ran the sim with our slot-aware binpack + preemption model. overall cost down ~28% vs single-sku A100, but 99p latency increased for chat workloads when H100 nodes filled with many small pods. possible NVLink / PCIe contention.
marta: hmm — were those small pods multi-gpu or single-gpu with big batch sizes? curious if packing strategy is putting many single-gpu jobs on the same host and saturating interconnect.
jamal: single-gpu tasks, batch size ~8. scheduler packed them onto H100 8-GPU hosts to reduce wasted slots. that lowered cost but we saw token-level tail latency spikes during KV cache warmups and large attention windows.
sophia: can we add a soft constraint: avoid >X concurrent decode pods on a single host if mean_seq_len > 512? fallback to A100 if host saturation detected. also metric: evictions_per_minute by instance_type.
jamal: here's the quick fallback policy I tested (pseudocode):
```json
{"fallback_policy": [{"from":"h100","to":"a100","max_concurrent_fallback":2,"trigger":"interconnect_saturation"}],"pack_strategy":"slot-aware","max_fill_pct":0.85}
```
alex: nice. what about preemptible price variability? if H100 spot price drops 60% sometimes it's worth it even if latency bump is 10–15ms tail. we need a decision surface: cost_delta vs tail_latency_delta mapped to SLA penalty.
marta: agree. also region differences — us-east-1 showed fewer H100 evictions in last 30d than us-west-2. maybe run portfolio that weights region_preempt_prob.
sre-bot: testing-runner: simulation job 4923 completed — metrics uploaded to s3://redwood-infra/sims/4923/ (csv + perf hist).
sophia: next action: implement runtime metric `interconnect_utilization` + a simple controller that reduces per-host packing when util > 0.7 for > 60s. fallback window = 3m. we can try as a canary in us-east-1 first.
jamal: can run the canary — need budget approval for extra H100 on-demand for 4 hours to seed cold cache and stress. estimate ~$1.2k.
alex: ok to approve. let's keep the slot-aware policy but add a latency-cost threshold: if cost savings > 25% and tail latency delta < 8ms, allow aggressive packing; otherwise prefer lower-saturation hosts.
marta: also add a small perf test that toggles `max_fill_pct` between 0.7 and 0.9 and records 95/99p. that'll give a clear curve.
sophia: will sketch the controller today. jamal, can you run canary tomorrow morning?
jamal: yep — starting 09:00 PT. will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
alex: awesome — thanks. goal: preserve overall unit-cost improvements while keeping 99p within SLA cliff. if we get good numbers, we'll bake into autoscaler.
sre-bot: deploybot: canary controller rollout to us-east-1 (1/3) scheduled at 09:15 PT.
